title: Quick-Fix Aerated Syrian Rice Biryani
description: A quick and flavorful Syrian rice dish made with salt, featuring a cultured, aerated twist to add depth and complexity to your meal. This dish is a perfect one-pot meal for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the oil in a salt block wok over medium heat.
Add the onion, ginger, and garlic, and sauté until the onion is translucent.
Add the rice and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes to coat with the oil.
Add the cumin, coriander, turmeric, and cayenne pepper, and stir-fry for another minute.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover with a lid, and cook for 15-20 minutes or until the rice is cooked and fluffy.
Stir in the lemon juice and salt to taste.
Transfer to a serving platter and garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro or parsley, if desired.
